title: Compare the curves
text: Since $$1+cos\left(\theta\right) \geq cos(\theta)$$ for every θ, the circle $$r=cos(\theta)$$ lies completely inside the cardioid. So the area is the area of the cardioid minus the area of the circle.

title: Compute each area
text: The cardioid has area $$\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}**{2\pi}(1+\cos\theta)**2\,d\theta=\frac{3\pi}{2}$$ and the circle $$r=cos(\theta)$$ has radius $$\frac{1}{2}$$, so its area is $$\frac{\pi}{4}$$. The answer is $$\frac{3\pi}{2}-\frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{5\pi}{4}$$.
